edit.description: the recording-shell fixture and the default-shell assertion, made host-honest

summary: three declared-shell cases red on the win32 lane: a shebang fixture win32 cannot spawn, and an assertion reading the host's own resolution of `sh`
acceptance: the windows lane runs the three declared-shell cases green or skips each with its host stated, never silently, and the posix lane's verdicts are unchanged.
notes: Windows lane, run 35156732271. `recordingShell` writes an extensionless `#!/bin/sh` file and chmods it +x — neither carries on win32; and `an undeclared shell runs a command gate under sh` asserts `$0` is `sh` where git's sh reports `/usr/bin/bash`. No line is judgeable: all three are green on every posix judge, so the lane is the verdict. A new platform fact here is the human's to write.

A bare-string stamp already on disk reads as the run with no titles.

The leading-run half of the bound stays judgement and stays prose. Plan phases only — build writes no cursor.
